origin.description: Reads an SPSS .sav or .zsav file into a tibble.
origin.usage: read_sav(file, encoding = NULL, user_na = FALSE, col_select = NULL, skip = 0, n_max = Inf, .name_repair = "unique")

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: A path or the raw bytes.

arguments.name: user_na
arguments.text: When true, user-defined missings are kept on a labelled_spss column.

arguments.name: col_select
arguments.text: Column names or 1-based positions to keep.

origin.details: With user_na false, defined missings become NA. Dates and times follow the SPSS format.

translation.description: Reads an SPSS .sav or .zsav file into a tibble.
translation.usage: read_sav(file, encoding=None, user_na=False, col_select=None, skip=0, n_max=float("inf"), name_repair="unique")

arguments.name: file
arguments.text: A path or the raw bytes.

arguments.name: user_na
arguments.text: When true, user-defined missings are kept on a labelled_spss column.

arguments.name: col_select
arguments.text: Column names or 1-based positions to keep.

translation.details: With user_na false, defined missings become NA. Dates and times follow the SPSS format.
translation.example:
from haven import read_sav
d = read_sav("/home/ahmed/R/library/haven/examples/iris.sav", n_max=2)
print(d.nrow, d.columns[0].values)
